resolution.note: weak-tests diffs with rename detection; rename is a move

title: weak-tests accepts a renamed test file as a move, not a deleted test
body:
Why: lane refactor-context moved test files from test/claude/ to test/context/ and weak-tests flagged them as deleted tests (red), so the lane moved them back; tests now sit outside the area they cover (r-node-test mirrors src area).
Outcome: weak-tests treats a git rename of a test file (same tests, new path) as a move, not a deletion.
Proof: a weak-tests test with a renamed test file passes; one with a removed test still fails.
